evidenceLevels.stable: Verified against the live gateway and covered by automated tests.
evidenceLevels.beta: Covered by automated tests (and a real Redis in CI where relevant). Not validated against the live gateway.
evidenceLevels.experimental: Implemented and tested against the simulator only. May change.

checkout_session_initialize.name: Session Initialization (/check-out/initialize)
checkout_session_initialize.notes: Exercises RSA-PKCS1 encryption and RSA-SHA256 digital signature handshake.
checkout_session_initialize.evidence: automated tests against the local simulator; NOT TESTED against the live gateway (sandbox access needs onboarding credentials)

checkout_complete.name: Order Placement & Complete (/check-out/complete)
checkout_complete.notes: Completes handshake, exchanges challenge, and retrieves hosted checkout URL.
checkout_complete.evidence: automated tests against the local simulator; NOT TESTED against the live gateway

payment_verification.name: Payment Verification (/verify/payment)
payment_verification.notes: Mandatory server-to-server callback verification comparing order ID, amount, and signature.
payment_verification.evidence: automated tests against the local simulator incl. tampered amount, order id and merchant id; NOT TESTED against the live gateway

payment_status_check.name: Payment Status Check
payment_status_check.notes: Server-side inquiry by paymentReferenceId with automated PII masking.
payment_status_check.evidence: automated tests against the local simulator

crypto_provider_node.name: Native Node.js Crypto Provider (OpenSSL 3)
crypto_provider_node.notes: Native Node.js crypto provider. Works on Node 22+; on Node 18/20 the client switches to the pure-JS decryption automatically.
crypto_provider_node.evidence: golden-vector tests; passes on Node 22 and 24; on Node 18.20 and 20.20 (OpenSSL 3.0) node:crypto rejects RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 decryption, so those tests are skipped there

crypto_sha1_fallback.name: Legacy SHA1withRSA Signature Support
crypto_sha1_fallback.notes: Optional signature algorithm (signatureAlgorithm: "SHA1") for accounts that Nagad configured for SHA-1.
crypto_sha1_fallback.evidence: unit tests only; not validated with a real SHA-1 account

crypto_purejs_fallback.name: Pure-JS PKCS#1 v1.5 decryption (automatic fallback)
crypto_purejs_fallback.notes: BigInt RSA decryption used automatically when node:crypto cannot decrypt (Node 18/20), or explicitly with PureJsCryptoProvider. Not constant-time; for decrypting Nagad responses only.
crypto_purejs_fallback.evidence: tests on Node 20 (full suite) and a full create+verify smoke run on Node 18.20.8; compared with node:crypto ciphertexts; NOT TESTED against the live gateway

crypto_edge_runtimes.name: Edge / Serverless Runtimes (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge)
crypto_edge_runtimes.notes: Not supported: WebCrypto has no RSAES-PKCS1-v1_5, and the SDK relies on node:crypto for signing and encryption.
crypto_edge_runtimes.evidence: Not supported: WebCrypto has no RSAES-PKCS1-v1_5

session_store_memory.name: Memory Session Store (Dev-Only)
session_store_memory.notes: Atomic create-if-absent and 30s CAS lease claims for local development.
session_store_memory.evidence: automated tests against the local simulator (race and replay tests)

session_store_redis.name: Redis Session Store (Distributed Lua CAS)
session_store_redis.notes: Atomic Lua transitions, configurable TTLs, and 7-day replay prevention tombstones.
session_store_redis.evidence: automated tests against the local simulator with a real Redis service in CI

session_store_kv_rest.name: Upstash / Generic KV Session Store
session_store_kv_rest.notes: REST-based session persistence (Upstash, Cloudflare KV, Vercel KV) for serverless platforms without TCP connections.
session_store_kv_rest.evidence: unit tests with a fake KV

express_adapter.name: Express Adapter
express_adapter.notes: Thin wrapper around standard Web Request/Response handler.
express_adapter.evidence: tests inside real Express (with and without a body parser) through create and verify

nextjs_adapter.name: Next.js App Router Adapter
nextjs_adapter.notes: createNextRouteHandler for App Router route handlers.
nextjs_adapter.evidence: tests: route handler answers create; web-standard Request/Response

hono_adapter.name: Hono Adapter
hono_adapter.notes: Native Web Request/Response adapter for Hono.
hono_adapter.evidence: tests inside real Hono (node-server) through create and verify

react_native_webview.name: React Native WebView Integration
react_native_webview.notes: In-app WebView checkout with hardware back-button and deep-link handling.
react_native_webview.evidence: callback interception tested without a device; NOT TESTED on a physical device

angular_service.name: Angular Service (NagadService)
angular_service.notes: Plain TypeScript service (extend it and decorate with @Injectable()).

mock_simulator.name: Local Test Simulator & Throwaway Key Generator
mock_simulator.notes: Zero-dependency HTTP simulator for deterministic CI and offline development.
mock_simulator.evidence: used by the test-suite; not published to npm

refund.name: Programmatic Refund API
refund.notes: Not supported: use the Nagad merchant portal.
refund.evidence: Not implemented: no verifiable public specification. The raw() escape hatch is not provided for it.

http_handler.name: HTTP handler (create, callback)
http_handler.notes: The server decides amount and order; callback origins are allowlisted; unknown sessions fail closed; minimal responses.
http_handler.evidence: automated tests against the local simulator: tampering, allowlist, fail-closed, error mapping

proxy_egress.name: Forward-proxy egress (fixed IP)
proxy_egress.notes: createForwardProxyFetch for serverless platforms that need a whitelisted static IP.
proxy_egress.evidence: unit tests; NOT TESTED against a real proxy

fastify_adapter.name: Fastify plugin
fastify_adapter.evidence: tests inside real Fastify through create and verify

koa_adapter.name: Koa middleware
koa_adapter.evidence: tests inside real Koa through create and verify

other_adapters.name: Remix, SvelteKit, Astro, Nitro and Nest adapters
other_adapters.notes: Thin wrappers over the web-standard handler.
other_adapters.evidence: Remix, SvelteKit and Astro: Request/Response tests; Nitro and Nest: NOT TESTED in a real framework
